body.x: Digital conversion platform Cocktail Cloud 4.0 released
Integration of edge computing, AI, multi-hybrid cloud technology
NAMUTECH (CEO Chul Jung) will showcaseits digital conversion platform Cocktail Cloud 4.0 at the CES 2020, the world'slargest IT and electronics show held in Las Vegas on January 7-10.

In CES 2020, 4,500 companies from aroundthe world will participate to introduce various new technologies and newproducts related to artificial intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT),cloud, 5G mobile communications, smart cities, smart homes, cars, and robots.
In Asia this year, major companies likeSamsung Electronics, LG Electronics, NAMUTECH, Hyundai Motor Company, Doosan,Toyota, Huawei, Lenovo and Nikon will participate.
NAMUTECH will showcaseCocktail Cloud 4.0 which combines edge computing and AI technology in CES2020.

Cocktail Cloud 4.0 is a digital platform (PaaS) that enablescompanies to use the cloud-native platform for implementation. It was based on the experience of building DevOps, 5G, AI,blockchain and smart city platforms.
This makes it easy to manage private and publicclouds, and the operation is integrated with DevOps environment.

NAMUTECH proved its technological capabilities by passing the Certified Kubernetes Conformance Program run by Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) for the first time in Korea in the cloud product sector. CEO Chul Jung said, “The trend for these days is to service cloud, AI, big data, and smart city technologies in one digital platform. We will gain the competency of the future new technology by exhibiting in CES to further develop our next-gen cloud technology and show it to the world.”

NAMUTECH (www.namutech.co.kr), thecloud-based integrated solution company, was founded on November 11, 2001. Byfocusing on the virtualization market, it has acquired various implementationachievements and patents.

NAMUTECH provides a wide range ofproducts, including self-developed hybrid cloud platform Cocktails Cloud andalso the virtualization solution NCC (Namu Cloud Center), Citrix, Dell EMC,and Google Cloud Platform to the market.
